item.title: Monotonicity and inequalities for the ratios between two Bernoulli polynomials
item.description: arXiv:2405.05280v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the work, the authors establish the monotonicity of the ratios \begin{equation*} \frac{B_{2\ell-1}(s)}{B_{2\ell+1}(s)}, \quad \frac{B_{2\ell}(s)}{B_{2\ell+1}(s)},\quad \frac{B_{2m}(s)}{B_{2\ell}(s)},\quad \frac{B_{2\ell}(s)}{B_{2\ell-1}(s)}, \end{equation*} where $B_\ell(s)$ denotes the Bernoulli polynomials. From these newly-established monotonicity results, the authors derive some new inequalities and recover several known inequalities of the Bernoulli polynomials $B_\ell(s)$, the Bernoulli numbers $B_{2\ell}$, and their ratios such as $\frac{B_{2\ell+2}}{B_{2\ell}}$.
item.dc:creator: Zhen-Hang Yang, Feng Qi
